author: blu
body: Proves Fog: prevention of all combat damage this turn. A 5/5 attacks a defender sitting at 3 life -- lethal. The defender holds a Fog (an instant whose Oracle text "Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn." compiles to PreventCombatDamage) and an untapped Forest. Facing lethal, the AI casts the Fog; combat damage is skipped and the defender survives at 3. Without the Fog the same swing kills. This closes the prevention gap the engine deliberately left open (parse-primary-effect used to drop "prevent").
